anti_error_rules: US radar detection is not instant classification/fire solution; US CIC/CAP/AA and sortie cycles are finite systems.
Do not apply nationality labels as capability multipliers. Both sides pay fatigue, task saturation, repair, information-age and logistics costs.
Completed hull or produced airframe is not automatically combat-ready; separate completion, acceptance, work-up, readiness, allocation and mission effectiveness.
A lower-casualty choice must normally pay in geography, tempo, objectives or simultaneous-task coverage somewhere else.
Do not convert local forward adjudications into global time without checking all linked theaters every 10-14 days.
